warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.note: Warm-up only. Not a range builder.

warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.note: Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean. Hips stop you before the knee does.

warmup.name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
warmup.note: Slow, no hands if you can.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: From 90/90, torso down over the front leg to the floor and back. Hands assist at first; goal is the glute lifting you unaided.

warmup.name: Side plank
warmup.dose: 5 x 8 s per side, 2-3 s between
warmup.note: Knees or feet. No top-leg raise.

warmup.name: Side-lying hip abduction
warmup.note: NEW - you asked for this on 08-09. Straight top leg, lift to ~30 deg, no rolling back. If you still cannot feel the glute after two sessions, say so and it comes back out.

warmup.name: Seated good morning, unloaded
warmup.note: No bar. Hinge-pattern stretch, working toward depth.

warmup.name: Straddle hold
warmup.note: Capped at 60 s so it does not pre-fatigue the box squat.

A.session_notes: BACK FROM 12 DAYS OFF - and the week-1 learning deload is gone. Every load you have actually logged is now at full working weight. Overhead press came back RPE 5 at 35, which is nowhere near your ceiling: 37.5 is the scheduled step, but if the top single-set of 5 moves at RPE 6 or under, put 40 on it next time and tell the log. Bench top set goes to 75 for the triple - you were RPE 8 at 72.5 and the 84-87 estimate still stands, so keep feeding it. Pec deck starts 4.5 kg heavier with much bigger drops: you hit 29 reps total last time, which means the start was too light. Calf raises on the 45 sled during the bench rests - that worked, keep it.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - top set
exercises.notes: Front rack, in the rack, bail forward. NEVER behind the neck. +2.5 from what you actually lifted. RPE 6 or under here = go 40 next session.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - back-off
exercises.notes: ~85% of the top set. Ribs down, do not lean back to get under it.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: +2.5. Heaviest set first while fresh. This is the number that tells us where the real ceiling is.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: +2.5. First rep of each set paused 2 s on the chest. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45 (partial ROM)
exercises.notes: RPE 6 at 135 last time. Back up to full working load - 145 is a weight you have run before. Partial ROM, knee is the boss.

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: You doubled the 25 s to 45 s at RPE 6, so 45 s is the new target. Ribs down, do not hitch the hip. RPE 6 or under = 60 s next time.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Back to 7.5 from the 5 kg learning weight.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: 47 -> 33 -> 19 (nearest pin). Bigger drops: last time 43/33/19 gave 29 total reps, which means it started too light. Want 10-12 on the first drop, 22-26 total.

B.session_notes: This is the day that has NEVER been run in the new format, so it is not all at full weight and here is why. Three things are held deliberately: the trap bar is still gated (no symptom-free Day B on record yet, and the back log has 2 rows since 24 Aug so there is no evidence either way), the machine row stays at 20 kg because that was your own call after the 03-09 back pull, and the dip stays bodyweight because you have never done one here. Everything else is full weight: the pull-up top set is now loaded at +5 kg and the face pull goes back to the 40 you actually logged. Preacher drop set restructured - last time you got 13 total reps, which is a failed drop set, and the EZ curl that gassed you beforehand is gone. Calf raises in the row rests.

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: GATE: trap bar returns after one Day B with no back symptoms. Hip extension only - squeeze the glutes, chin tucked, STOP AT NEUTRAL, never arch past straight.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: First loaded pull-up - 5 kg on a belt or between the feet. You were RPE 7 at bodyweight. RPE 8 cap. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Bodyweight. Same cap, same stop rule.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: HELD AT 20 ON PURPOSE - your instruction after 25 pulled your back on 03-09. Not a progression slot until the back is quiet. RPE 8 cap. Calf raises in these rests.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: Bodyweight - you have never done this one, so today is the pattern. Stop at ~90 deg elbow, slight forward lean, do not sink. RPE 7 or under = add 5 kg next time.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Back to the 40 you logged on 03-09. Rear delts and scap retraction. If the last 5 reps need body english, drop to 30 and log it.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 30 -> 20 -> 15. Starts LIGHTER than the 35 that gave you 7 reps, with much bigger drops. No EZ curl before it now, so you arrive fresh. Want 10-12 on the first drop, 22-26 total.

C.session_notes: Also never run in the new format, but unlike Day B nearly all of it is movement you have logged, so it goes to full weight. Box squat top set 55 - the number you backed off from on 06-09 with a tender back; nine sessions at 40-55 have produced zero back events, so it is earned. After the LAST box squat set stay standing and hold the bar racked 30-45 s - that hold IS the axial carry, and it replaces the barbell walk your gym is too small for. Hip thrust is the most under-loaded lift you own (40 kg at 80 kg bodyweight) so it takes the biggest jump. Pallof stays at 15: never done it, and loading it heavy defeats the point. Wrist + reverse curl superset in the hip thrust rests.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - top set
exercises.notes: Full working weight. Sit, do not collapse; stay tight on the box.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - back-off
exercises.notes: AFTER THE LAST SET: stay standing, hold the bar racked 30-45 s. Ribs down, breathe. This is the carry exposure.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - top set
exercises.notes: +7.5. Biggest jump in the programme and the most deserved one. Ribs down, 2 s squeeze, STOP AT NEUTRAL - do not arch over the top.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - back-off
exercises.notes: Same cues. Wrist curl + reverse curl superset in these rests.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (half-kneeling)
exercises.notes: 10 per side. HELD - first time doing it. Resist the rotation, do not press fast. If 15 is trivial, log it and it goes to 20.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: 22.5 - the target you missed at 3 sets on 06-09 is reachable at 2.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: 15 for both sets. You dropped to 12.5 last time to stop pulling with the back - stand against a wall or sit if that happens again.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 10 -> 7.5 -> 5. Last time you ran all three at 7.5, which is not a drop set. Want 10-12 on the first drop, 22-26 total.
